description:
About the job

Creator Partnerships & Affiliate Growth Lead
About Flowerburst

We are the fastest growing and most disruptive business in publishing since Amazon. 




Flowerburst starts movements — ideas that burst into life radiantly. Publishing is broken: more than 80 percent of Americans feel they have a book in them, and only about 1 percent ever publish it. After taking 2-3 years to go to market, nine out of ten traditionally published titles fail to turn a profit. Why? There are three middle men between the author and end customer, and there simply isn’t enough margin for any party to invest in marketing. 




Success on self-publishing platforms like Amazon KDP is even more elusive – they leave authors marketing blind and without cashflow: Amazon KDP doesn't show authors who their customers are and where they came from, and pay 60+ days after a sale is made. The result is centuries of gatekeeping in which the best ideas rarely reach the people who need them, dying on shelves in the back of bookstores, undiscovered. We are building the company that fixes this: an AI publishing platform fused with social, direct-to-consumer commerce. The AI platform allows anyone, anywhere to compile their idea in book form - helping the author exactly where they need it. Social commerce allows authors to place books in the heart of culture – social media feeds – to get discovered, even by audiences who typically don’t read books. Anyone, anywhere can write a book and get it to the masses. The end goal is a literary revolution.




The flywheel is already turning and validation has been immediate. In under 12 months since prototype launch, we’ve grown to $7.5M ARR (GMV run rate), and we are one of the top book sellers on social commerce platforms like TikTok Shop; we operate our own publishing imprints, and a creator/affiliate program of hundreds of active creators. Over the next quarter, we’re releasing our own titles (we publish at the speed of movements, not years), and within the next year, we’re opening up our platform so any author – regardless of station in life – can put their idea on paper and bring it to people who are eager to hear it.




The team is scrappy, ambitious, fast-moving, and highly entrepreneurial.




About the Role

We are hiring a Creator Partnerships & Affiliate Growth Lead to own and scale one of the most important parts of Flowerburst’s growth engine: our TikTok Shop affiliate and VIP Special Ops creator program.




This is not ordinary affiliate management.




Flowerburst has access to a large catalog of top-selling books and uses performance data to identify products with viral TikTok Shop potential before the broader market fully catches on. When we find those products, we bring them to selected creators with a compelling offer: higher commissions, product insights, performance analysis, content hooks, sample support, GMV Max support, and a real partnership designed to help them grow their GMV.




The goal is to help creators win. When creators consistently post around the right products, the upside can be substantial for both the creator and Flowerburst.




You will manage relationships with top TikTok Shop affiliates and BookTok creators, convert them into active VIP partners, and help them produce more videos that sell books. You will be responsible for turning creator interest into posting commitments, repeat content, GMV growth, and long-term creator partnerships.




This is a creator-facing growth role for someone who is organized, persuasive, commercially minded, and excited to help build a repeatable creator revenue engine.




What You’ll Do

You will manage Flowerburst’s VIP creator pipeline from outreach to activation.




This includes identifying promising creators, sending personalized outreach, following up, tracking next steps, coordinating samples, sharing product briefs, asking for posting commitments, monitoring creator activity, and reporting what is working.




You will help build creator launch pods around new book releases and high-potential VIP products. For each campaign, you will help match the right creators with the right products, share content angles, track sample delivery and first posts, and encourage creators to post multiple videos rather than just one.




You will build relationships with creators so they see Flowerburst as one of their best affiliate partners. You will give them useful product insights, help them understand why certain books may resonate with their audiences, and make them feel like part of an insider program.




You will also help build the operating system behind the program: clean tracking, weekly reporting, repeatable follow-up workflows, creator briefs, and simple SOPs.




Responsibilities
Manage a pipeline of TikTok Shop affiliates and BookTok creators
Invite high-potential creators into Flowerburst’s VIP Special Ops Program
Send warm, persuasive, personalized outreach and follow-up messages
Clearly explain the creator opportunity and why selected products may help creators grow GMV
Track creator status, next steps, samples, posting commitments, and performance
Coordinate with internal operations on creator samples
Help creators understand which books to post and what angles may work
Build and manage creator launch pods for new book releases and VIP products
Ask creators for specific posting commitments
Track first post date, number of videos posted, repeat posting, and GMV
Re-engage creators who have sampled from Flowerburst in the past
Report weekly on creator pipeline, activity, and performance
Identify which creators, products, and content angles deserve more investment
Improve outreach, follow-up, campaign briefs, and creator management workflows




What Success Looks Like

In your first 30 days, you will learn Flowerburst’s products, creator program, and TikTok Shop affiliate workflow. You will understand the VIP Special Ops pitch deeply enough to explain it clearly to creators. You will clean up the creator tracker, follow up with warm creator leads, make sure every creator has a clear status and next action, help launch active creator pods, and establish weekly reporting.




You will also build a repeatable workflow for creator outreach, onboarding, follow-up, and campaign management. You will increase the number of VIP creators actively posting, track sample-to-post and post-to-GMV performance, help creators post multiple videos per campaign, own creator follow-up with minimal founder involvement, and create reusable creator briefs and campaign templates.




In your first 60 days, you will own the VIP creator program day-to-day, manage multiple creator launch pods, improve creator activation and repeat posting rates, and give leadership clear reporting on what is working.




In your first 90 days, you will help turn Flowerburst’s creator program into a predictable launch channel for new books and high-potential VIP products.




You Might Be a Fit If
You write excellent English
You communicate in a tone that is warm, casual, direct, and professional
You are highly organized and detail-oriented
You follow up consistently without needing reminders
You are comfortable managing many conversations at once
You have experience in creator partnerships, influencer marketing, affiliate marketing, account management, sales development, customer success, ecommerce, or partnerships
You are comfortable using spreadsheets, Airtable, Notion, HubSpot, or similar tools
You can work independently and take ownership
You are comfortable asking people for commitments and following up when they do not deliver
You can understand performance data and translate it into simple, compelling creator-facing communication
You are interested in TikTok, creators, social commerce, books, media, or ecommerce




Bonus Points
Experience with TikTok Shop
Experience with influencer or affiliate programs
Experience working with U.S.-based creators
Experience in ecommerce or social commerce
Experience managing launch campaigns
Experience creating creator briefs or campaign briefs
Familiarity with BookTok, publishing, books, or media
Experience in a fast-moving startup environment
Experience with Shopify, TikTok Shop Seller Center, affiliate platforms, or creator CRM tools




Location and Schedule

This is a full-time remote role.

We are equally interested in candidates based in South Africa, LATAM, and the Philippines.

You must be able to communicate with U.S.-based TikTok creators and affiliates during meaningful U.S. business-hour overlap, especially Eastern and Pacific afternoons.




Compensation

Expected base compensation:

$2,500–$3,500/month USD
Up to $4,000/month USD for an exceptional candidate




There is also significant performance bonus potential for measurable GMV growth.




This role has meaningful upside for the right person. If you help Flowerburst activate strong creators, increase repeat posting, and materially grow GMV from managed creator relationships, we want you to share in that success.




The bonus structure will be finalized after baseline performance and attribution are clear, but it will be tied to outcomes such as creator activation, videos posted, repeat posting, and incremental GMV from managed creators.




What We’re Looking For

We are not looking for a generic virtual assistant.




We are looking for someone who feels like a high-performing account manager, creator partnerships operator, or affiliate growth manager. You should be proactive, commercially minded, organized, and excellent in written communication.




The goal is not just to send messages. The goal is to turn creator relationships into videos, repeat posting, GMV, and long-term creator partnerships.




The right person should be excited about the opportunity Flowerburst can offer creators. We are bringing creators data-backed product opportunities, improved economics, performance support, and a real chance to grow their GMV.

description:
About the job

About the Team

The Consumer Performance Marketing team owns the execution of paid social acquisition across Meta, TikTok, and Snapchat. We operate at scale across the U.S. and Canada, managing complex builds, pacing routines, live optimizations, QA workflows, and experiment cycles that directly impact consumer growth.

We work closely with U.S.-based Channel Managers, Creative, Analytics, and Martech, functioning as one integrated performance engine. This requires strong operational discipline, fast signal interpretation, and a mindset focused on translating platform behavior into clear, actionable steps.

While the team is execution-heavy, we also influence strategy by shaping testing agendas, surfacing insights, and partnering with platform reps on betas and new product rollouts. It's a high-ownership environment for operators who thrive in fast, data-driven systems.

About the Role

This role owns the tactical execution of Consumer paid social campaigns end-to-end. You will build, QA, pace, optimize, and iterate campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and Snap, managing multi-million-dollar budgets with precision.

You'll partner with U.S. teams and platform reps to run experiments, test new bidding approaches, evaluate audience structures, and support creative testing. You will also be expected to diagnose issues quickly, communicate insights clearly, and maintain structurally sound accounts.

This position requires someone who can execute with technical depth, think analytically, and move fast — ensuring each optimization ties directly to performance outcomes.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…


Be a part of our first DoorDash team in our Mexico City office!

You are proficient in the English language

Strong quantitative, analytical and problem-solving skills; must be very comfortable with data analysis and able to use data to make decisions and conduct experiments.
Experience with Web & App Tracking/Attribution (preferred)

Experience working on multi-sided marketplace businesses (preferred)


About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. description:
About the job

About The Role

The Revenue Marketing team is responsible for generating and accelerating the pipeline that grows Shopify's business with mid-market and upmarket merchants. We're looking for a Senior Lead, Demand & Digital Field Marketing to create demand across AMER Sales Segments.

You will be the marketing counterpart of our sales leaders rely on: the person who turns their territory priorities into programs that produce qualified pipeline. You'll lead the strategy on sales play, signals, and digital field programs. That means a quarterly play calendar built against real opportunity types (new logo, expansion, competitive displacement, closed-lost win-back), buying signals actioned into outreach that reps actually run, and a portfolio of virtual events, webinars, gifting, and incentive programs that create demand.

You'll partner with Growth Marketing on targeted campaigns so the top of the funnel and the plays underneath it point at the same accounts.

We're looking for a leader who is equally comfortable in a territory review with sales leaders and demand programs. You set the bar for execution quality, and you're measured on quality pipeline. Your key KPIs are inbound and outbound Sales Accepted Leads (count and value), in alignment with the AMER sales team's targets.

Key Responsibilities:


Responsible for the AMER sales play system: build the quarterly play calendar against pipeline targets,land it with sales leadership, and execute to drive pipeline
Own pipeline generation numbers in Sales forecast calls and be able to translate Marketing-led programs into pipeline impact
Equip reps with plays they will actually run: clear positioning, ready-to-send outreach, supporting content, and a defined follow-up motion
Turn product, account, and intent signals into prioritized outreach and campaign triggers, and define which signals matter most to action
Partner with sales and funnel operations on routing, follow-up SLAs, and speed to lead so signals convert instead of aging
Own our digital-first field portfolio: virtual events, executive roundtables, webinars built as demand programs, gifting and incentive programs, and activations around major industry moments
Partner with Growth Marketing on targeted campaigns and paid programs that reach priority accounts and feed consistent, quality pipeline
Report performance to marketing and sales leadership weekly in a form that drives decisions, and build measurement into every program before it launches
Put AI agents and tooling to work on program build, reporting, and campaign production. 



Qualifications


Strong track record of building demand or field marketing programs that hit pipeline and revenue targets in B2B SaaS, ecommerce, or technology
Direct experience partnering with sales leaders as a peer. Bring a strong spirit of collaboration and “win together” attitude
Demonstrated ownership of Sales pipeline and programs, including sales plays or account-based programs
Experience running virtual events, webinars, and executive programs as pipeline vehicles, with clear before-and-after numbers
Strong analytical skills. You're fluent in funnel and pipeline data, can interrogate a dashboard, and can design an experiment with a hypothesis and a kill criterion
Working knowledge of the modern marketing and CRM stack (marketing automation, CRM, intent and signal data, campaign attribution)
Excellent written and verbal communication. You can compress a complicated program into a paragraph a sales leader will read
Keen interest in AI and a habit of putting agents and tools to work on your own programs, reporting, and production
Resilient and resourceful in the face of ambiguity, and able to thrive on change rather than endure it
Strong understanding of the ecommerce market, mid-market merchant needs, and the competitive set



About Shopify

Opportunity is not evenly distributed. Shopify puts independence within reach for anyone with a dream to start a business. We propel entrepreneurs and enterprises to scale the heights of their potential. Since 2006, we’ve grown to over 8,300 employees and generated over $1 trillion in sales for millions of merchants in 175 countries.

This is life-defining work that directly impacts people’s lives as much as it transforms your own. This is putting the power of the few in the hands of the many, is a future with more voices rather than fewer, and is creating more choices instead of an elite option.

About You

Moving at our pace brings a lot of change, complexity, and ambiguity—and a little bit of chaos. Shopifolk thrive on that and are comfortable being uncomfortable. That means Shopify is not the right place for everyone.

Before you apply, consider if you can:


Care deeply about what you do and about making commerce better for everyone
Excel by seeking professional and personal hypergrowth
Keep up with an unrelenting pace (the week, not the quarter)
Be resilient and resourceful in face of ambiguity and thrive on (rather than endure) change
Bring critical thought and opinion
Put AI agents and tools to work on the tasks they're built for, and focus on the work only humans can do
Embrace differences and disagreement to get shit done and move forward
Work digital-first for your daily work



We may use AI-enabled tools to screen, select, and assess applications. All AI outputs are reviewed and validated by our recruitment team.

About the job

This role requires the candidate to work on-site in Ciudad de México (CDMX), Mexico.

Client Overview

Our client is a confidential, licensed financial technology company operating a rapidly growing digital lending platform in Mexico. Backed by an international technology group with deep expertise in artificial intelligence, big data, and digital financial services, the company provides innovative consumer finance solutions that promote financial inclusion through technology-driven lending products.

Operating in one of Latin America's fastest-growing fintech markets, the organization combines advanced digital platforms, data-driven decision-making, and robust risk management to strengthen its market position while maintaining strict regulatory compliance.

As part of its continued expansion, the company is seeking an experienced executive to lead its marketing organization in Mexico, driving brand growth, customer acquisition, and commercial performance. Please note that this is a confidential executive search. The company name and additional details will only be disclosed to shortlisted candidates during the interview process.

Job Role

The Marketing Director will lead the overall marketing strategy, brand development, customer acquisition, and commercial growth initiatives for the Mexico market. Reporting directly to the Board of Directors, this executive role is responsible for aligning local marketing strategies with global business objectives while overseeing integrated campaigns, marketing operations, agency partnerships, and organizational leadership.

The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in accelerating business growth, expanding market share, and strengthening the company's position within Mexico's competitive fintech landscape.

Key Responsibilities


 Develop and execute the overall marketing strategy, brand positioning, and growth roadmap for the Mexico market. 
 Lead integrated marketing campaigns across digital marketing, brand management, social media, influencer marketing, public relations, partnerships, and performance marketing.

 Collaborate closely with executive leadership, product, operations, and regional marketing teams to ensure alignment with global strategies. 
 Ensure all marketing activities comply with applicable financial advertising regulations and industry compliance standards.

 Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Economics, or a related discipline. 
 Mexican national. 
 Minimum 8–10 years of progressive marketing experience, including senior leadership or director-level responsibilities.

 Strong leadership experience managing cross-functional marketing teams and external agency partners. 
 Background in FinTech, Digital Lending, Financial Services, Digital Banking, Technology, E-commerce, or high-growth consumer businesses is highly preferred. 
 Deep expertise in digital marketing, brand management, performance marketing, social media, influencer marketing, and customer acquisition.

 Excellent executive leadership, stakeholder management, strategic planning, and communication skills.

At Bristol Myers Squibb, we are inspired by a single vision – transforming patients' lives through science. We bring a human touch to every treatment we pioneer. Join us and make a difference.

Job Summary

The Brand Lead, Hematology is a strategic and executional leader responsible for driving the commercialization of Reblozyl (Luspatercept) and support for the next launches in Cell Therapy in the market. This individual will develop and implement integrated brand strategies that reflect a deep understanding of the public and private healthcare market dynamics, including specialty and high-complexity treatment settings. As part of the BMS Hematology Commercial team, this role plays a pivotal part in ensuring speed to patients, cross-functional alignment, and business excellence in a highly competitive therapeutic landscape.

Job Description

The Brand Lead reports to the Franchise Lead, Hematology, and serves as the brand strategy owner for the hematology portfolio and supports the launch of Cell Therapies. This individual will be the orchestrator of a cross-functional brand team, translating scientific and clinical evidence into compelling commercial strategies that resonate with hematologists, multidisciplinary teams, and healthcare institutions across both public (institutional/government) and private market segments.

We are seeking a results-driven, patient-centered professional, passionate about hematology and experienced in specialty/high-complexity product management, who brings strong strategic acumen, executional discipline, and proven launch excellence capabilities aligned with the BMS Commercialization Model.

Key Responsibilities

Brand Strategy & Commercialization


Lead the development and execution of the annual brand plan for Reblozyl and Cell Therapies, including situation analysis, strategic imperatives, tactical mix, and investment allocation.
Define and manage the brand positioning, messaging architecture, and value proposition for Reblozyl and Cell Therapies across all customer segments.
Drive Reblozyl and Cell Therapies launch readiness and execution, coordinating all pre-launch and launch activities across commercial, medical, market access, regulatory, and supply functions.
Develop and monitor brand performance KPIs, adjusting strategies and tactics based on market insights and competitive intelligence.
Digital Innovation & Omnichannel Excellence Proven ability to lead integrated omnichannel campaigns that seamlessly connect field force, digital, and medical channels to deliver a consistent and impactful brand experience; hands-on experience applying Artificial Intelligence and advanced analytics tools to anticipate market trends, improve customer segmentation, and drive data-informed commercial decisions in specialty hematology.


Market Insights & Customer Understanding


Lead market research and analytics initiatives to generate deep understanding of the hematology landscape, unmet needs, patient journey, and stakeholder dynamics.
Map and analyze public market (IMSS, ISSSTE, IMSS Bienestar) dynamics, formulary processes, institutional protocols, and purchasing cycles.
Monitor private market dynamics including managed care, hematology networks, key hematology centers, and high-specialty hospitals.
Integrate insights from field-based teams, medical affairs, and market access to continuously evolve brand strategies.


Cross-Functional Leadership


Lead and energize the Brand Team (TAS/Sales, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Regulatory, Patient Advocacy, Finance) ensuring cohesive strategy and aligned execution.
Partner with Medical Affairs to ensure the scientific platform supports commercial objectives within compliance guidelines.
Collaborate with Market Access to develop value-based tools and evidence strategies for institutional access (public tenders, CBNSS inclusion).
Work closely with the global brand team to align local strategy with global brand direction.


Launch Excellence


Own and drive the Hematology pipeline launch plan, from pre-launch readiness assessment to first patient use and post-launch tracking.
Lead development of launch promotional tools, training materials, and go-to-market plans for Hematology pipeline across public and private channels.

description:
About the job

Hey, Dingus!




Yeah, you heard that right.




Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a Brand Operator to join our growing team! You’re probably thinking, “Wtf is a Brand Operator?” Keep reading. 👀




Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency, but here’s the thing most agencies won’t tell you: having a website isn’t a strategy. Neither is posting on Instagram three times a week. A blog without a traffic plan is a diary. A newsletter nobody opens is a chore. Every tactic we run exists to answer one question: how does this move someone from ”never heard of you” to “shut up and take my money”? That’s the job. Blogs feed SEO. SEO feeds traffic. Traffic feeds the funnel. The funnel feeds revenue. If a tactic doesn’t connect to that chain, we don’t run it just to look busy. We provide an unlimited get-shit-done subscription, minus the shit that doesn’t get anyone anywhere.




Purpose of the Role




The Brand Operator combines client relationship ownership with hands-on marketing production. You are the client’s main point of contact and one of the people actually making the work happen. This role exists because most agencies force clients to choose between “someone who understands your brand” and “someone who can execute.” We don’t think that tradeoff should exist, and neither will you.




About You




Highly motivated and passionate about delivering excellent work
Multifaceted, someone who steps up to the challenge
Proactive, always thinking about the needs of a client before they are
Strong communicator, ensuring clarity with both internal teams and clients
Professional level of English (written and spoken)
Friendly, respectful, and able to work effectively within a team
Detail-oriented, organized, and resourceful — you find answers when needed and make sure things are running smoothly
Excellent time management and ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously
A background in marketing is essential
Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, specifically) as part of your daily workflow as a way to move faster and think better




The Skill Requirements




You need real, hands-on proficiency in at least 3–4 of the following:




Short-form video editing (Reels, TikTok, etc)
Social media strategy, content creation, and scheduling
Newsletter writing and editing
Brand strategy and positioning
Copywriting (web, ads, email, social)
Design fundamentals (Canva, Figma, or similar)
Basic analytics and reporting (knowing what a number means, not just where to find it)




Coordination skills alone will not meet the bar for this role. We already know you can manage a project. We need to know what you can build.




Main Objectives




1. Client Relationship Ownership

Serve as the primary point of contact for your clients, understanding their goals well enough to make calls without needing a meeting first
Run regular check-ins, reviews, and strategy conversations that actually move the account forward, not just status updates
Translate client goals into a point of view, not just a task list




2. Hands-On Production

Personally execute against your core skills (video, social, newsletter, copy, brand, design, wherever you excel)
Use AI tools, especially Claude, to speed up ideation, drafting, and iteration. We want to see how you think with AI as a collaborator, not just how fast you can type a prompt
Maintain a quality bar on your own output before it goes to review, not after




3. Internal Collaboration

Work with designers, copywriters, media buyers, and other Operators to fill gaps outside your core skills
Keep project tools (ClickUp and similar) current and accurate without needing to be chased
Give and receive direct feedback — we skip the sandwich method here




4. Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving

Help shape brand and marketing strategy for your accounts, not just execute against someone else’s plan
Continuously look for workflow improvements, especially ones involving AI, that let you do more without more hours
Manage multiple accounts without letting them quietly rot




Important Notes

Our operating hours are from 9 am to 5 pm MST, Monday to Friday.
The minimum level of written & spoken English required for this role is professional.




Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now! Let’s get talking, get making, and go get that bacon.

About the job




Job Title:- Market Integration Specialist

Location:- Mexico/Latam (Remote)

Duration:- Contract




Job Description :




Position Summary

The Market Integration Specialist at Client supports the company’s ongoing expansion by assisting with the analysis and integration of mergers and acquisitions (M&A) within Client’s North American Managed Services Organization (MSO) business segment.

Working closely with the Director of Market Integration, North America, this role supports timely and accurate evaluation of potential acquisitions and helps ensure alignment with Client’s IT Infrastructure Standards, Policies, and Procedures. The position leverages automation, data analytics, and Client‑provided AI‑enabled tools to improve the efficiency, consistency, and quality of integration activities across due diligence, discovery, and post acquisition execution.




Key Responsibilities

Pre‑Sign

Support pre‑due diligence, due diligence, and sign‑to‑close activities by gathering and organizing essential information related to prospective acquisitions.
Perform evaluations of technology, operations, and compliance to identify risks and integration considerations.
Utilize automation and data‑driven techniques (e.g., standardized intake templates, automated validation, AI‑assisted analysis) to improve the efficiency and repeatability of pre‑sign activities.

Infrastructure Analysis

Assess existing technology assets, systems, and workflows to determine compatibility and integration requirements.
Identify opportunities to standardize, automate, or modernize infrastructure and operational processes as part of the integration roadmap.
Collaborate with enterprise teams to support the use of automation or AI‑enabled services that reduce manual effort and improve visibility, security, or compliance pre‑ and post‑sign.

Discovery and Secure

Collaborate with acquired entities and internal M&A teams to perform post‑close discovery activities.
Support implementation of Client standards, processes, and procedures, and facilitate coordination with Enterprise Infrastructure and Cloud (EIC) and broader Global Data and Technology Solutions (GDaTS) teams.
Assist with adoption of enterprise automation platforms, workflows, and AI‑assisted tools used for service intake, asset discovery, security posture assessment, and operational reporting.




Focus Areas: RCA and MSO Operations

This role provides targeted support for current and future M&A activity involving Retina Consultants of America (RCA) and One Oncology (OO) managed service organizations, each with distinct operational models and integration requirements.

The Market Integration Specialist works closely with Client’s M&A and enterprise teams to support timely and effective integration, contributing to business continuity and scalability. This includes supporting integration approaches that leverage automation, standardized data models, and AI‑enabled insights to efficiently execute and incorporate Client standards, services and processes across MSOs.




Qualifications

1. Education and Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related field.

Experience working with enterprise infrastructure teams and navigating complex organizational environments.

Working knowledge of automation and low‑code/no‑code platforms, scripting, or orchestration tools.
Exposure to AI‑enabled tools for data analysis, documentation, or process support, with an understanding of their responsible use in enterprise IT environments.

3. M&A‑Specific Experience

Experience supporting IT due diligence for mergers and acquisitions.

description:
About the job

Description

You will design and grow the partner network that brings Latin American businesses into selling on Amazon in the US — building something with regional reach and a direct line to measurable growth.

This role covers Mexico and Latin America. You'll build relationships with agencies, service providers, industry associations, and logistics companies, and turn those relationships into a sustainable, scalable channel for new seller recruitment.

Key job responsibilities

Design and execute the regional partner recruitment strategy: identify which types of organizations have the right relationships and client profile to bring new sellers to the US marketplace, and develop the approach for each category.

Build and develop partner relationships across Mexico and Latin America — understanding what drives each type of organization, what they value, and how to structure engagement that works for both sides long-term.

Develop the lead generation model: determine which channels, co-marketing formats, and outreach approaches grow the seller pipeline most effectively, and evolve the approach as the program scales.

Work across internal teams to ensure sellers entering the program are positioned for strong, sustained performance from day one.

Own program performance end-to-end: partner activity, pipeline health, seller quality, and revenue contribution. Know your numbers and act on them.

Verificar la identidad del cliente y validar datos base de contacto de acuerdo con los procedimientos y controles operativos autorizados, antes de comunicar cualquier información de la oferta.

Confirmar la elegibilidad y condiciones de la oferta precalificada (producto, monto/línea, vigencia, condiciones clave) en los sistemas y herramientas autorizados, evitando promesas fuera de lo autorizado.

Comunicar de manera clara, precisa y transparente las características, beneficios, restricciones, requisitos, tasas, comisiones, CAT cuando aplique, costos, condiciones y vigencia de la oferta, asegurando la comprensión del cliente.

Registrar de forma correcta, completa y oportuna cada interacción en los sistemas autorizados: resultado de llamada, estatus de venta, motivos de rechazo/no contacto, acuerdos, seguimiento y evidencias requeridas.
Cumplir con objetivos individuales de ventas, conversión, productividad y calidad, tales como contactos efectivos, tasa de cierre, cumplimiento de script, calidad de captura y auditorías de llamada.

Asegurar el cumplimiento de políticas internas, controles operativos, estándares de conducta y normativa aplicable en México, incluyendo confidencialidad/privacidad de datos, prácticas de venta responsable y comunicación transparente.
Contribuir a un ambiente de control interno sólido, identificando y reportando oportunamente incidentes, desviaciones, posibles fraudes, malas prácticas, riesgos operativos o quejas del cliente.
Brindar una experiencia positiva durante todo el contacto: trato respetuoso, lenguaje claro, ritmo adecuado, empatía, y cierre cordial independientemente del resultado.
Participar en calibraciones, coaching y capacitación continua, aplicando retroalimentación para mejorar argumentación, calidad de llamada y resultados.

Resiliencia ante el rechazo.

Cualificar rápido y manejar objeciones.

About the job

About Us

HireHawk connects skilled professionals around the world with meaningful opportunities at U.S. and Canadian companies, helping businesses build high-performing remote teams without limiting talent by geography. We value ownership, clear communication, and people who care about getting the details right, while providing structured onboarding and support for professionals working remotely.




About the Role

As a Customer Operations Coordinator, you’ll support the day-to-day operations of a New York-based business, making sure sales orders, pricing, costs, and customer information are processed accurately and efficiently. You’ll start with a strong focus on back-end operational work, then take on more direct customer communication as you learn the business and demonstrate proficiency.

This is a role for someone who thinks rather than simply processes. When a number, price, margin, or order does not make sense, you’ll be expected to investigate it, double-check the information, and confidently raise questions before moving forward.




Responsibilities

Enter and review sales orders accurately, ensuring customer, product, pricing, and order information is complete before processing.

Investigate information that appears incorrect or inconsistent rather than processing it without question.
Escalate discrepancies and proactively communicate with the appropriate team members to reach a resolution.
Maintain a high level of accuracy while efficiently handling significant volumes of order and operational data.
Support customer inquiries professionally through email as your knowledge of the business grows.

Learn the company’s logistics, order management, pricing, and operational workflows well enough to recognize when something does not look right.

Must-Have:

Previous customer service, customer-facing, or operational support experience.
Advanced English proficiency across speaking, writing, and reading.
Strong numerical skills and confidence working with percentages, costs, margins, multiplication, division, and basic business calculations.

Experience working with spreadsheets, order management platforms, ERP systems, or similar business software.
Previous experience communicating with U.S.-based customers or teams.

We are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys building relationships, creating impact, and helping customers succeed. This is a proactive, performance-driven Customer Success role focused on engagement, retention, customer happiness, and long-term growth within existing accounts.

This position combines a base salary with a meaningful performance-based incentive structure. A key part of the role is achieving measurable customer retention, engagement, and growth goals, with quarterly bonus opportunities tied directly to these results. The ideal candidate is motivated by this type of compensation model and comfortable being accountable for defined performance targets.




This is not a reactive support position. Success in this role means not only building strong customer relationships, but also turning those relationships into measurable business outcomes through retention, increased engagement, adoption, and account growth.

We move fast, adapt constantly, and build while doing. The ideal person enjoys ownership, human connection, and the opportunity to help shape and improve how things are done as the company grows.




What You Will Do

Build Meaningful Customer Relationships

Become a trusted partner throughout the customer journey.
Conduct proactive outreach, pulse checks, customer reviews, and strategic follow-ups.
Build long-term relationships focused on trust, engagement, and customer success.
Advocate for customer needs internally.
Create memorable customer experiences that drive loyalty and long-term partnerships.
Maintain regular and meaningful communication with your assigned customer portfolio.

Drive Customer Success and Retention

Monitor customer health, engagement trends, platform usage, and adoption metrics.
Identify churn risks proactively and develop strategies to improve retention.
Help customers maximize the value and outcomes they receive from the platform.
Manage escalations and difficult customer conversations with empathy and professionalism.
Improve customer engagement and long-term adoption.
Take ownership of customer retention goals and proactively address accounts that may be at risk.

Drive Customer Growth & Performance

Own and contribute to measurable customer retention, engagement, and account growth goals.
Identify opportunities to increase engagement and expand business within existing customer accounts.
Drive renewals, retention, upsell opportunities, and account expansion initiatives.
Proactively identify opportunities to increase platform usage and customer value.
Work toward defined performance targets that directly contribute to quarterly incentive compensation.
Track progress against customer success and growth metrics and take action when results are below target.
Balance customer happiness and relationship-building with measurable business outcomes.
Approach your customer portfolio with a growth mindset, looking for opportunities to strengthen relationships while contributing to long-term business growth.

Collaborate Cross-Functionally

Partner closely with internal teams to improve customer outcomes.
Work collaboratively with Sales, Operations, Product, and Customer Success teams.
Gather customer feedback and identify improvement opportunities.
Advocate internally for customer needs while balancing business priorities.
Support continuous improvement initiatives and scalable solutions.
Share customer insights that can help improve retention, engagement, and growth strategies.

Build While Scaling

Help create and improve processes as the company grows.
Bring ideas, ownership, and initiative to improve the customer experience.
Create structure when processes or workflows are still being developed.
Adapt quickly as priorities, customer needs, and business goals evolve.
Thrive in an environment where change, experimentation, and continuous improvement are part of the day-to-day work.




Required Qualifications

Advanced / Fluent English communication skills (near-native preferred).
Must currently live in Guadalajara, Jalisco.
Valid U.S. Visa (required).
3+ years of relevant experience in areas such as: Customer Success, Account Management, Client Success, Customer Engagement, Relationship Management.
Experience managing a U.S. based customer portfolio or book of business.
Demonstrated experience growing existing accounts. You should be able to explain your personal role in identifying an opportunity, presenting a solution, and contributing to increased usage, expansion, or revenue.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Experience working in dynamic, fast-paced, and evolving environments.
Comfortable managing competing priorities and changing business needs.
Demonstrated resilience and ability to perform effectively under pressure.
Comfortable working in a growing and evolving environment where processes and workflows continue to be refined. Must be proactive, adaptable, and able to take ownership, create structure, and move initiatives forward as the role and business evolve.
Comfortable working in a performance-driven environment where a meaningful portion of total earning potential comes from quarterly bonuses tied to measurable results.




Experience With

Customer retention metrics.
Customer engagement KPIs.
Customer health scores.
Customer adoption strategies.
Renewals.
Upsell and cross-sell initiatives.
Account growth programs.
Expansion within existing customer accounts.
Managing difficult customer conversations.
Cross-functional collaboration.
Working toward measurable customer or business outcomes.




Preferred Experience

SaaS, technology, healthcare, senior living, staffing, or other customer-centric industries.
CRM platforms such as HubSpot or Salesforce.
Experience building processes or programs from scratch.
Previous experience working with performance-based incentives, quotas, revenue targets, retention goals, or similar measurable objectives.




What We Are Looking For

Someone who:

Builds trust naturally and creates authentic relationships.
Loves creating customer happiness while understanding the business impact of strong customer relationships.
Is approachable, personable, and relationship-oriented.
Thinks proactively instead of reactively.
Brings empathy, ownership, resilience, and strong communication.
Handles difficult conversations calmly and professionally.
Is naturally curious and enjoys learning.
Takes initiative and goes above and beyond.
Enjoys ambiguity and building while moving fast.
Thrives in startup and high-growth environments.
Collaborates effectively across teams.
Balances customer happiness with retention and business growth.
Is motivated by measurable goals and enjoys seeing strong performance reflected in their earning potential.
Is comfortable working toward targets and being accountable for results.
Brings energy, positivity, and a strong bias toward action.
Enjoys being a strategic partner rather than simply providing support.




Compensation Structure

This role offers a base salary plus quarterly performance-based incentives.

Candidates should be comfortable with a compensation model where achieving and exceeding defined performance goals can meaningfully increase their total earnings.

description:
About the job

Organization- The Standard, Mexico City

Summary

The Standard, Mexico City arrives in the historic Tabacalera neighborhood with character, color, and a signature wink. With 206 guestrooms, 27 branded residences, vibrant dining destinations, and a rooftop overlooking the Monumento a la Revolución, we're bringing our unmistakable energy to Latin America.

We're looking for a Guest Experience Supervisor to help shape how our guests see, feel, and remember The Standard. We’re searching for someone intuitive, engaging, and naturally tuned in to the people around them—someone who knows that great hospitality is less about following a script and more about knowing when to change it.

The Opportunity

At The Standard, guest experience is not a department—it’s a point of view.

As our Guest Experience Supervisor, you’ll help create stays that feel effortless, personal, and full of character. You’ll lead by example, support the Guest Experience team, and work across the hotel to turn good moments into memorable ones. Whether welcoming a first-time visitor, helping a regular feel instantly at home, or finding the right solution when plans change, you’ll make sure every interaction feels distinctly The Standard.

What You'll Do


Supervise the daily operation of the Guest Experience team.
Create warm, engaging, and personalized interactions throughout the guest journey.
Anticipate guest needs and identify opportunities to make each stay more memorable.
Welcome and connect with VIPs, repeat guests, long-stay guests, and special occasions.
Share thoughtful recommendations that help guests experience Mexico City beyond the hotel.
Handle guest feedback and service recovery with confidence, empathy, and good judgment.
Coordinate closely with Front Office, Housekeeping, Food & Beverage, Concierge, and other hotel teams.
Ensure guest preferences, requests, and important information are communicated and followed through.
Monitor guest feedback and identify trends or opportunities to elevate the experience.
Support the training, coaching, and development of Guest Experience colleagues.
Ensure the team delivers service that is consistent, genuine, and never overly scripted.
Assist with VIP planning, special moments, hotel activations, and guest-facing experiences.
Maintain accurate records, shift handovers, and relevant guest experience reports.
Step in as a leader on duty when needed and help keep the operation moving smoothly.


Qualifications

What You'll Bring


Previous experience in Guest Experience, Guest Relations, Concierge, Front Office, or a similar hospitality role.
Experience in a luxury lifestyle hotel, boutique hotel, or high-energy hospitality environment.
A natural ability to connect with people from different backgrounds and cultures.
Strong communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent judgment and the ability to remain composed in unexpected situations.
A genuine interest in Mexico City, its culture, neighborhoods, food, art, and nightlife.
Strong attention to detail and an instinct for anticipating what guests may need next.
Experience handling guest feedback and service recovery.
Fluency in English and Spanish, with the ability to confidently engage with an international clientele.
Flexibility to work varied shifts, weekends, and holidays.
A curious, confident, and personable approach that feels right at home at The Standard.


If you bring curiosity, confidence, and a natural talent for making people feel at home, we’d love to meet you.

About the job

¡Bienvenido a The Palace Company!

The Palace Company se distingue en el ámbito de la hospitalidad de lujo por ofrecer experiencias incomparables a través de nuestros exclusivos hoteles, resorts y clubes vacacionales a nivel internacional. Impulsados por una profunda pasión por el servicio, nos dedicamos a crear momentos inolvidables para nuestros huéspedes, cada uno de ellos diseñado con esmero y sofisticación.

Con una trayectoria que se remonta a más de 40 años, somos pioneros en la creación de vacaciones de lujo, marcando un antes y un después en la industria. Nuestra presencia abarca México, Jamaica, Italia y Maldivas, con 17 hoteles de categoría mundial, una planta de alimentos, un exclusivo club vacacional Palace Elite, una agencia digital In House, y tres oficinas corporativas. Además, contamos con cinco divisiones estratégicas que abarcan Operaciones, 




Corporativo Mérida

En la vibrante ciudad de Mérida, Yucatán, se encuentran nuestras oficinas corporativas, un edificio de alta tecnología ubicado en la mejor zona de la ciudad, con acceso directo a una de sus plazas más icónicas, que ofrece una variedad gastronomía y entretenimiento de lujo. Nuestro complejo corporativo, de 13 pisos, ofrece vistas panorámicas excepcionales de la ciudad, así como espacios únicos de trabajo que incluyen salas de videoconferencia, comedores modernos, cocinetas equipadas y amplias zonas de colaboración diseñadas para fomentar la creatividad y productividad de nuestro equipo.




Compras

Únete a nosotros y sé parte de un equipo que lidera el mercado global, abriendo nuevos horizontes y creando oportunidades exclusivas para nuestros clientes. Desde adquisiciones estratégicas hasta la expansión de destinos y servicios, impulsamos el crecimiento y la innovación en cada paso. Nuestra división de compras, especializada en áreas clave como Alimentos y Bebidas, Equipos de Operación, Proyectos CAPEX y Cadena de Suministro, es fundamental para garantizar la eficiencia y excelencia en nuestra operación hotelera.




Tu Oportunidad

Como Especialista de Strategic Sourcing, tendrás la oportunidad de diseñar e implementar estrategias de abastecimiento con alcance corporativo y regional, gestionando categorías clave de MRO y Facilities para nuestras diferentes propiedades y unidades de negocio.

Además, podrás incorporar metodologías y mejores prácticas de otras industrias para transformar la manera en que gestionamos nuestras categorías de abastecimiento.




Objetivo del puesto

Desarrollar e implementar estrategias corporativas y regionales de abastecimiento para las categorías asignadas, optimizando el costo total de propiedad y asegurando condiciones competitivas de calidad, disponibilidad y servicio. Generar ahorros sostenibles mediante el análisis de costos, consolidación de demanda, estandarización, innovación y desarrollo de proveedores, en coordinación con las áreas técnicas y usuarias.

description:
About the job

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

You will play a key role in delivering a world class, 6 star experience to new clients during their early journey with Kraken. As part of a high performing, round the clock team renowned for its commitment to client care and industry leading security, you'll ensure every client feels supported from day one, and that any barriers to their success are proactively removed.

This role offers a fixed term contract, for the duration of 6 months.

Manage client onboarding and verification, including KYC document review and validation, as well as funding and general inquiries via email and live chat
Guide existing clients through document resubmission and re-verification during remediation initiatives
Identify and escalate potential risks or suspicious documentation to the appropriate teams

Assist clients with fiat funding and withdrawals, ensuring smooth, compliant transactions

Maintain accurate client information and adhere to AML/CTF policies and QA/Risk Management frameworks
Collaborate cross-functionally, using client and operational feedback to continuously improve onboarding and support workflows


What You Bring


2+ years of experience in a customer service or business support role where you have proven to be a pro at delivering a 5 star experience. This can be within retail, hospitality, or a customer service center

Strong knowledge of and passion for cryptocurrency and the digital asset industry
Understanding of CSAT drivers, dissatisfaction factors, and NPS metrics
Quick to grasp new concepts, systems, and process changes, and skilled at explaining complex procedures clearly to clients and internal stakeholders
Exceptional attention to detail, with strong workflow accuracy and process adherence
Highly organized, with excellent time management across multiple priorities in a fast paced environment

Experiencia comprobada liderando e implementando marcos de Gobernanza y Calidad de Datos en entornos corporativos de mediano o grande tamaño.
